_doc: Level E (slim Pokemon-trainer) proportions, DESIGN strand 2026-10-26. Multipliers/offsets are relative to the AB4 rigid parts (v2/hy3d/partsAB4f, renders v2/parts/out/AB4/renders) in reproportion.py format; apply with scripts/make_rig.sh v2/design/PROPORTIONS_E.json E. 'targets' are in reproportion_solve.py's OWN measure definitions and equal what these multipliers already produce (solver exits at iteration 0). The design-side 2D numbers (crown excl. bun/bow to sole, outer shoulder incl. sleeve caps, obi waist, hem width, all over hair-mass head width) are in 'design_2d' and were matched on the meshes with v2/design/tools_e/m3.py.
source_front: v2/design/turnE/front.png (Level E front; measured frontE_19: 3.32 heads, shoulders 0.65, waist 0.40, hem 0.78, legs 0.40 -> final design pushed to the lead targets below)
camera_note: All design_2d numbers are TRUE FRONT (orthographic, 0 deg elevation), like the design sheet. In the 30-deg-elevated game camera (rig_parts.py rest_S) the same rig reads ~3.15 heads with legs ~0.40 because vertical limbs foreshorten (cos30) while the round head does not. That is expected; do not re-solve for the elevated view.
pixel_notes: 48 px figure (64 cell): head ~14 px tall/wide, face ~8 px, neck 1-2 rows x 3 px, shoulders ~10 px, obi waist ~7 px, hem ~11 px, legs >=4 px wide incl. selout outline (never 1px K both sides on a 2-3 px leg), boots 4-6 px long.
